items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: That was way before I talked about Louis Dumais.

ctx.x: You played with his band too? Yeah. Not for a long time now, yes? Yeah, yeah.
You did? Mm-hmm. That's when I was doing all the traveling. Because there was a traveling band. I was deep in depression. That was way before I talked about Louis Dumais.
Was that before you played with the La Vida band?
